{{Top|leg}}
'''H'merrigs''' were [[Biot|biological constructs]] created by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. They were used to dispense food from a few raw materials, and were vital for any Yuuzhan Vong distanced from the rest of their society (whether by choice or by necessity).
